name: Menu Force - Taxonomy Menu UI
description: Makes sure a taxonomy term gets added to the menu system on specific vocabularies.
project_description:
This module enables you to make the Menu Settings required on specific content types.

 It forces content types to be included in the menu system before the content will be saved. Furthermore, it disables and auto-enables the 'Add menu item' checkbox and makes the title field mandatory. 

 This can be useful in a number of situations, e.g. when using [menupath-raw] in the pathauto settings, which expects a node to live in the menu system. 

 This module makes sure it does.

 Development of this module is sponsored by LimoenGroen .
